A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ProbRes framework and contain readable text, equations, figures, and tables. v1 includes supplementary Sections 7–12; the supplied v2 ends after the references. Their omission can be distinguished from extraction gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original recognition experiments in Tables 1–2, component ablations in Figure 3, and supplementary analyses of priors, embeddings, and search-space coverage.

after.justification: v2 retains the original ProbRes benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative search analysis in Tables 1–2 and Figures 3–4.

M1.justification: Both versions retain ConceptNet priors, embedding-based search-space ordering, exploration and exploitation, local refinement, and action-object re-ranking. Algorithm 1 replaces argmax with top-k notation, but v1 already describes refinement over K candidates; this does not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate L1 recognition on GTEA Gaze, GTEA Gaze+, EK100, and Charades-Ego, and L2/L3 recognition on the first three datasets. No benchmark, application domain, or recognition scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains ALGO, KGL, ALGO+LAVILA, LAVILA-Decomp, EGOVLP-Decomp, LAVILA, and EGOVLP. Table 2 retains the same LAVILA and EGOVLP comparisons against their ProbRes variants.

E3.justification: The main recognition metrics, backbones, and query budgets are unchanged. Omitting v1 Section 10 removes an auxiliary evaluation protocol: t-SNE/UMAP analysis of 1,000 random activity labels and a tomato-related subset, assessed using silhouette scores and nearest-neighbor consistency.

E4.justification: v2 omits substantial supplementary diagnostics: the prior-versus-likelihood bias case study, global and within-category embedding analyses, and generated-search-space overlap analysis in v1 Sections 9–11. The main component ablations and search-trajectory case study remain, but these additional investigations are not relocated.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests for its results. The omitted clustering scores are diagnostic metrics, not uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: The benchmark values in Tables 1–2 and main ablation findings are unchanged. v2 removes auxiliary results, including global silhouette/neighbor-consistency scores of 0.06/0.25, tomato-subset scores of 0.08/0.07, and the dataset-specific search-space overlap counts reported in v1 Sections 10–11.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1, line 12, changes the formal candidate-set specification from argmax to top-k, matching the existing K-candidate description. This is a limited mathematical correction; Equations 1–5 remain unchanged, and Section 3.2.2 still retains the older argmax expression.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same central claims: ProbRes, the L0–L3 taxonomy, improved recognition with fewer VLM queries, and limitations of VLM text embeddings. Removing supplementary support does not itself change these retained claims.

C2.justification: v2 retains the main limitations in Section 6 but omits v1's explanation that static, domain-agnostic ConceptNet priors can cause high-prior/low-likelihood search detours, together with the recommendation to adapt prior weights to video content. Broader embedding and search-space curation caveats remain.

D1.justification: v2 omits the exact Gemini prompts, vocabulary and word-length constraints, detailed manual-curation instructions, generated concept counts, and validation-set tuning clarification from v1 Sections 8 and 11. Hardware and main hyperparameters remain. The new promise of public code after review does not replace these missing reproducibility details.

R1.justification: The same 62 references are retained. Section 2 changes the stated limitation of existing VLMs from a fixed search space defined during training to one defined during inference, a limited but substantive correction to the comparison with prior work.

P1.justification: The retained main text receives limited wording reductions, an author-name correction, equal-contribution attribution, and acknowledgment edits. Sections 1–6 retain their order. Supplementary Sections 7–12 are omitted, while the main exposition is not extensively rewritten or reorganized.

P2.justification: v2 removes the prior/likelihood plot, four-panel embedding visualization, and taxonomy table from v1 Figures 5–6 and Table 3, substantially reducing the visual evidence. Figure 2(a) is also simplified and rearranged, with mathematical arrow labels removed and a trajectory typo corrected. Main benchmark displays remain substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the benchmark results and makes useful local corrections, but loses the exact L2/L3 search-space construction instructions and supplementary bias, embedding, and coverage evidence. This substantially weakens reproducibility and support for the retained embedding-limitations contribution. References to supplementary details remain without that material in the supplied PDF; the small corrections do not offset these losses.
